dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: Welcome to the House of Hesperides. I'm Oksana, the lobby receptionist. What can I do for you, dear guest?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you get lots of guests?

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: In truth... Fewer humans find themselves invited here. Most of our guests are Snegovik who live elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: That said, this place did once receive many different types of guests.

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: All who bear an invitation are welcome in this house.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Snegovik and Snegurochka...

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: Hmmm... Are you concerned about the difference in terms of address? Well. Let me see how I should explain this...

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: If I had to sum the situation up in a sentence... the female Snegoviks are also known as Snegurochka.

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: "Snegovik" is the name of our race as a whole, while "Snegurochka"... is a name that human tales have given to our ladyfolk, which seems to have caught on for various reasons...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't need anything right now, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: Alright. If you should require anything, please do tell me...
